target: local dev server (next dev, webpack) shown through the Cloud browser preview origin
method: Cloud browser (Chromium 154) rendered the real app inside same-origin iframes sized 1440x900 and 390x844, so viewport media queries, svh units and layout use the target viewport. Effective hit areas were measured by probing document.elementFromPoint outwards from each control until the point no longer belongs to it. Local Playwright Chromium could not launch in this VM (missing libnspr4.so) and Browserless cannot reach the owner-gated preview origin, so the Cloud browser was used.

provinceMarkers.dataSource: The workspace has no database (.env.local is 0 bytes and app/lib/db-init.js getSql() returns null), so /map rendered its empty state. A temporary local story fixture in getLuckyStoryMap, gated by LUCKY_STORIES_FIXTURE=1, supplied 6 stories across BC, AB, ON, QC, NS and NL for the measurement only; it was reverted with git checkout before commit and never entered the diff.

afterFix.note: Effective areas are larger than the 3 px ring because the decorative marker-sparkle layer also belongs to the button.
